note: Each lab environment is a separate uv project with its own lockfile; their Transformers requirements conflict, so they are never merged. Install with scripts/bootstrap.py. Paths are relative to the repository root.

cpu.purpose: D05-D07, the ml-demo CLI, reports and contract tests

mlx.purpose: D01, D02 and D04 MLX language models (Apple Silicon)

rlvr.purpose: D03 TRL GRPO training and PyTorch evaluation

notebooks.purpose: Visual Jupyter lessons; no model downloads
